fallback.note: NO round_field discriminator on M278: GameplayTriggerType is GTT=2 only on the 80 Path-A burst OPENERS (all 5,514 other ST160 rounds GTT=0, incl. the ~692 Path-A continuation rounds) so a round_field discriminator MISLABELS them; RewardLastNode is never on ST160 rounds (0/5,594). Omitting a usable round_field discriminator makes the extractor use the trigger_anchor_walk fallback. The walk reads the opening paid ST140 (round_ctx.last_paid_round): Path B = a 590x pid present in PayoutIdToWinAmount with win==0 (661/661 win==0, VERIFIED); Path A = CollectCount==1000 (80/80, VERIFIED). Disjoint+exhaustive: 80+659=739 bursts, 0 both, 0 neither.

trigger.note: No single round-level trigger pid: ST160 JewelFeverRespin (cost=0, free hold-and-respin) is opened by TWO disjoint paths into the SAME ST160 event — (A) the BuffCollection peak (deterministic: CollectCount==1000 on the opening paid ST140, +1 every paid spin, ~0.10%/paid spin; ST140 carries NO 590x pid), and (B) a JewelFever jewel hit (random: the opening paid ST140 carries a 590x pid in PayoutIdToWinAmount with WIN==0 — a trigger marker that pays nothing; ~0.82%/paid spin), with 3 skin sub-paths (5901/5902/5903 <-> Red/Blue/Green). 739 bursts = 80 peak + 659 jewel, 0 ambiguous (VERIFIED). The per-round GameplayTriggerType is GTT=2 ONLY on the 80 Path-A openers (NOT a per-round discriminator — it mislabels the 692 Path-A continuation rounds), so the trigger_paths block uses the trigger_anchor_walk fallback, not a round_field discriminator. AccCredits (=10xCollectCount) is a derived metronome counter, not a payout pot, never paid as credits. ST160 settles ONCE per burst on the single Settle=True (always-last) round; all intermediate respins win 0 (win-INDEPENDENT hold-and-respin). ST160 carries NO natural payid (PayoutIdToWinAmount {} on 5,594/5,594) -> attributed by the m278_jewelfever_settlement SynthesizePayIdRule.

The anchor walk reads the opening paid ST140: 590x pid win==0 (Path B) / CollectCount==1000 (Path A). VERIFIED disjoint+exhaustive.

SKIN<->PID label mapping: 5901/5902/5903 <-> Red/Blue/Green adopted from W1 §3 + W2 §dimension; it is a LABEL cosmetic — the trigger-path SPLIT (session/round/win/band per path) is correct regardless of which jewel-color label decorates which pid (the anchor match is purely 'payout_id present with win==0'). Breaker confirms the per-path skin tally; if a pid pairs with a different color, the labels (not the structure) are corrected.

DOUBLE-590 edge: a few opening ST140 rounds carry two 590x codes (661 code occurrences vs 659 bursts). Under additive_sessions the extractor routes them to a surfaced multi:<A>+<B> ALARM bucket (+1 session to each path), never silently merged. Identical to M275's 1-in-909 double-trigger edge.

The fleet-wide pattern (user-confirmed 2026-06-12 on M275, gate-8): a real progressive jackpot store that the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0; the sample correctly shows 0. Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in both ST signatures, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface populates it, the parser picks it up unchanged.
